description: This file implements a watchdog driver for NXP Kinetis microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS, including setup, disable, install timeout, feed, and interrupt handling functions.

methods.name: mcux_wdog_setup
methods.description: Configures the watchdog with specified options, enabling or disabling stop and debug modes.

methods.name: mcux_wdog_disable
methods.description: Deinitializes the watchdog and marks the timeout as invalid.

methods.name: mcux_wdog_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a new timeout configuration for the watchdog, including window mode and callback.

methods.name: mcux_wdog_feed
methods.description: Refreshes (kicks) the watchdog to prevent it from resetting.

methods.name: mcux_wdog_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for watchdog, calls callback if registered.

methods.name: mcux_wdog_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device, including configuring interrupts.
